classification_rule: No nonzero solid penetration is accepted as contact without a drawing or physical interface definition. Classification closes interpretation only, never a geometry repair.

pairs.cause: Roller/body proxy occupies uncut longeron volume.
pairs.correction: New rail corridor, bearing gaps and deflected sweep; rerun dynamics/mass/brake.
pairs.study_disposition: RETAIN_FAILED_OR_UNRESOLVED_CONFIGURATION; NO CLEARANCE OR INTENDED CONTACT CLAIM

pairs.cause: Adapter/hub/gusset proxy occupies another part; no joint drawing proves intended contact.
pairs.correction: Replace with parametric adapter, explicit datum, cutouts and verified load path.
pairs.study_disposition: RETAIN_FAILED_OR_UNRESOLVED_CONFIGURATION; NO CLEARANCE OR INTENDED CONTACT CLAIM
